content: Resend (resend.com/pricing, npm resend 6.40.1): Free 3,000 emails/month, 100/day, 3 domains (per fetched pricing page); Pro 20 USD/month for 50,000; multi-region sending on all plans. Cloudflare Email Service sending is still beta, Workers Paid only (3,000/month included then 0.35 USD per 1,000).
